scenes.title: Cold open: the problem with shorthand
scenes.visualPlan: Black text on light document-texture field: NO EVIDENCE? then scope cards for what, where, standard, date, followed by DOES NOT MEAN NO RECORDS.
scenes.notes: No fake documents. Use typography and simple lines only.

scenes.title: The source event
scenes.visualPlan: Zoom from GAH brief URL to archived Senate hearing page and source manifest hash card. Add posture tags for official Senate source material, official caption source, GAH hearing-exchange summary, human-audio-certified exact short quotation, and editorial interpretation. State that only four short quotations are human-certified.
scenes.notes: Show no official stenographic transcript located as a source-status card. Do not use blanket certified-record wording.

scenes.title: The exact question and the narrow category
scenes.visualPlan: Highlight the Kennedy question from the exchange ledger, then draw a boundary box around other men to whom Epstein trafficked young women.

scenes.title: The answer and its qualifiers
scenes.visualPlan: First card: GAH hearing-exchange summary describes Blanche's answer as tied to DOJ/FBI files. Separate cards: human-certified short quotations as of now; That does not mean it did not happen. Then show reviewed-corpus versus universal-claim split.
scenes.notes: Do not imply the complete surrounding sentence was human-certified unless the quote ledger is expanded.

scenes.title: Records versus proof
scenes.visualPlan: Comparison table: record exists, can establish, cannot establish. Use icons for address book, calendar, photo, flight log, testimony.
scenes.notes: No person-specific names in this sequence.

scenes.title: What the public record establishes
scenes.visualPlan: Timeline: 2019 charge document, 2021 verdict, 2022 judgment, 2024 appeal. Labels distinguish party position from court finding. Source-spine card separates GAH hearing-exchange summaries from human-certified short quotations.
scenes.notes: Do not imply Epstein conviction or unnamed third-party finding.

scenes.title: What DOJ has not publicly shown
scenes.visualPlan: Four gap groups marked not publicly located in the reviewed package: Senate QFRs or written Blanche answers; person-specific DOJ declination, corroboration, credibility, or charging analyses; survivor-meeting follow-up documentation; complete official stenographic Day 1 transcript.

scenes.title: Related hearing exchanges
scenes.visualPlan: Three exchange blocks: Grassley, Durbin, Kennedy. For Grassley, show only the certified phrase investigate, indict, and prosecute as a direct quotation. Connect to contradiction-audit counters bounded by reviewed source package.
scenes.notes: Keep Grassley and Durbin separate from the decisive Kennedy answer.

scenes.title: The narrow conclusion
scenes.visualPlan: Final equation: no evidence in reviewed corpus does not mean no records, and records are not proof by themselves. End with corrections/source invitation.
scenes.notes: End card points to corrections and package review sources.
